name: How do professionals clean up sewage from a bathtub and bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals clean up sewage from a bathtub and bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional sewage cleanup involves several critical steps. First, technicians safely remove all standing sewage and contaminated materials. The affected areas are then thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and sanitized using industrial-grade antimicrobials to eliminate bacteria and odors. Specialized drying equipment is used to remove all moisture, preventing mold growth. Finally, affected structural elements and contents are assessed for repair or replacement to restore the bathroom to its pre-damage condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove sewage, clean and disinfect affected areas, dry thoroughly to prevent mold, and assess for repairs.
